description:
## Why
These four annotate parameters with `::` (00615 x4, 00632 x2, 01260 x4, 01360 x6), which Elixir refuses in a pattern. fz-ep5.5 makes `::` in a pattern an error and rewrites every such use in the repo.

## What changes
After fz-ep5.5 lands, each fixture (as ep5.5 left it) is wrapped in defmodule Main, its header reads `# oracle: self`, its twin is deleted and the golden regenerated. If a fixture's subject was the annotation itself, report that instead of converting.

## Signal
Four fewer .oracle.exs files; fixture_matrix and ORACLE=check pass for the four stems.
title: Fixtures 00615, 00632, 01260 and 01360 are their own Elixir oracle
